summary: Plan, execute, delegate, and finish bounded engineering work.

skills.choose_when: An approved implementation plan already exists and the user asks to carry it out.
skills.avoid_when: Do not use when the plan still needs to be written or key decisions remain unresolved.
skills.name: execute-plan

skills.choose_when: Implementation is complete and the branch must be verified, prepared for review/merge, handed off, or cleaned up.
skills.avoid_when: Do not use in the middle of active implementation.
skills.name: finish-development-branch

skills.choose_when: The user explicitly asks to save, transfer, resume, or reconstruct bounded task context for another agent or later session.
skills.avoid_when: Do not use for a conversational status summary, generic JSON export, commit message, or automatic context compaction.
skills.name: handoff-task-context

skills.choose_when: The runtime supports delegation and the task contains independent bounded subtasks or explicit multi-agent work.
skills.avoid_when: Do not use for a single blocking task or overlapping writes without isolation.
skills.name: orchestrate-agent-work

skills.choose_when: The user asks for a concrete implementation plan, migration plan, or file-by-file engineering plan.
skills.avoid_when: Do not use when an approved plan already exists and should be executed.
skills.name: plan-implementation
